funding.name: Idaho LAUNCH Grant
funding.provider: Idaho State Board of Education (Next Steps Idaho / Scholarship Idaho)
funding.provides: One of eight state-managed scholarships and grants applied for through the free Scholarship Idaho common application. The page lists Idaho LAUNCH as open and says FAFSA is not required.
funding.eligibility: All Scholarship Idaho programs require graduation from an Idaho high school, home school, or GED/HSE (per page). Recipients plan to attend a college, university or eligible training provider in Idaho.
funding.how_to_apply: Create an account on the Scholarship Idaho portal (no cost to apply), check qualifications, then apply. Contact idaholaunch@wdc.idaho.gov or 208-488-7575 with questions (per page).
